basic_details.job_title: FDDI Academic Career Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Two Academic Career Intern positions at the FDDI Head Office, Noida, are open for email applications to [email protected]. Applications must be sent in a single PDF file on or before 29 November 2026. The notice dated 19.11.2026 invites applications from FDDI (Footwear Design and Development Institute, एफडीडीआई) for an initial period of six months under the Office of Head – Academics.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: 1. Academic Career Intern – Academic Data Analytics, KPI Tracking, E-Cell Monitoring and Policy Documentation
2. Academic Career Intern – International Collaboration, MoU Activation, Academic Performance Reporting and Social Media Promotions

qualification.details: Both positions share the same eligibility rules in the notice: | Academic qualification: Bachelor's (UG) or Master's (PG) degree in Design, Management or Technology disciplines relevant to FDDI's academic programmes, from a reputed institution. Students currently in the final year of UG/PG programmes at FDDI are also eligible to apply. Academic performance: minimum 70% aggregate marks or 7 CGPA in the qualifying degree. Experience: prior work experience is not mandatory. Candidates should show sound understanding and depth of knowledge in their fields, as evidenced through academic projects, publications, research work or professional assignments. | Desirable attributes listed in the notice: | High learning agility, self-motivation, meticulous attention to detail and commitment to maintaining institutional confidentiality. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) or Google Workspace. Ability to prepare structured administrative reports, official notes, presentation decks and analytical summaries. Strong interest in emerging educational technologies, EdTech tools and contemporary design/technology trends. | The stipend is negotiable, within the limits prescribed under the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP) Policy. Other benefits are access to FDDI's library, software and other academic resources, and an Academic Career Internship Completion Certificate on successful completion of the programme. The initial duration is six (06) months.

selection_process: Applications received are scrutinised by the designated Intern Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates are invited to a two-stage selection process.
A presentation or practical demonstration to assess the candidate's domain knowledge and technical expertise.
An interaction to assess the candidate's suitability
potential and alignment with FDDI's academic environment. The notice does not print dates or a venue for either stage.
important_instructions: The engagement is governed by FDDI's Policy for the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP), as amended from time to time. Selected candidates must execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before joining the programme. The initial internship period is six (06) months. Any extension is governed by the ACIP Policy and is subject to performance, departmental requirements and approval of the competent authority. All intellectual property and outputs generated during the internship remain the property of FDDI. The internship is a structured learning engagement. It is not an employment contract and gives no right to employment with FDDI. Applications received after the closing date or found incomplete may not be considered.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee, and it does not print the stipend amount.

content_sections.heading: About FDDI
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of Head – Academics of FDDI, Head Office, Noida. The interns will provide analytical, administrative, research and coordination support to that office. The engagement runs under FDDI's Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP) Policy.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026. Use the prescribed format and attach scanned copies of the supporting documents, all consolidated into a single PDF file. The notice does not print the prescribed format itself. The email subject line must name the position applied for: "Application for Academic Career Intern – Position 1 (Academic Data Analytics)" "Application for Academic Career Intern – Position 2 (International Collaboration)" A candidate may apply for either or both positions, provided the eligibility criteria are met. Separate applications must be submitted, each showing the respective area of interest. Arrange the documents in this order: CV; educational certificates and transcripts from Class X onwards; portfolio of work/projects wherever applicable; other supporting documents such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Both positions share the same eligibility rules in the notice: Academic qualification: Bachelor's (UG) or Master's (PG) degree in Design, Management or Technology disciplines relevant to FDDI's academic programmes, from a reputed institution. Students currently in the final year of UG/PG programmes at FDDI are also eligible to apply. Academic performance: minimum 70% aggregate marks or 7 CGPA in the qualifying degree. Experience: prior work experience is not mandatory. Candidates should show sound understanding and depth of knowledge in their fields, as evidenced through academic projects, publications, research work or professional assignments. Desirable attributes listed in the notice: High learning agility, self-motivation, meticulous attention to detail and commitment to maintaining institutional confidentiality. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) or Google Workspace. Ability to prepare structured administrative reports, official notes, presentation decks and analytical summaries. Strong interest in emerging educational technologies, EdTech tools and contemporary design/technology trends. The stipend is negotiable, within the limits prescribed under the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP) Policy. Other benefits are access to FDDI's library, software and other academic resources, and an Academic Career Internship Completion Certificate on successful completion of the programme. The initial duration is six (06) months.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of roles and responsibilities for both positions: Academic Assistance: assist senior faculty in pedagogy, curriculum delivery, assignment preparation and classroom management for designated subjects. Academic Development: contribute to the development of course content, lesson plans and new curriculum under supervision. Institutional Projects: participate in and contribute to institutional projects such as craft documentation, cluster visits, workshops and research initiatives. Professional Conduct: maintain a professional work ethic, a daily log of activities, and submit a final project report. Uphold the confidentiality of all institutional information.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Academic transcripts and degree certificates (educational certificates and transcripts from Class X onwards) Statement of Purpose (SOP) outlining academic interests and career goals Portfolio of relevant work/projects, if applicable Other relevant supporting documents, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received are scrutinised by the designated Intern Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates are invited to a two-stage selection process. A presentation or practical demonstration to assess the candidate's domain knowledge and technical expertise. An interaction to assess the candidate's suitability, potential and alignment with FDDI's academic environment. The notice does not print dates or a venue for either stage.

It is not an employment contract and gives no right to employment with FDDI. Applications received after the closing date or found incomplete may not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 positions of Academic Career Intern, one in each of the two areas of specialization, at the FDDI Head Office, Noida.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the FDDI Academic Career Intern posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026. Applications received after the closing date may not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for FDDI Academic Career Intern?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's (UG) or Master's (PG) degree in Design, Management or Technology disciplines relevant to FDDI's academic programmes is required, with minimum 70% aggregate marks or 7 CGPA. Final-year UG/PG students of FDDI are also eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is work experience required?
faq.answer: No, prior work experience is not mandatory. Candidates should show depth of knowledge through academic projects, publications, research work or professional assignments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the FDDI Academic Career Intern?
faq.answer: The stipend is negotiable, within the limits prescribed under the Academic Career Internship Programme (ACIP) Policy. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your application in the prescribed format with scanned supporting documents, consolidated in a single PDF file, to [email protected] on or before 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for Academic Career Intern – Position 1 (Academic Data Analytics)" or "Application for Academic Career Intern – Position 2 (International Collaboration)", according to the position applied for.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both positions?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates may apply for either or both positions if they meet the eligibility criteria, but must submit separate applications showing their respective areas of interest.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Intern Selection Committee scrutinises applications. Shortlisted candidates take a Domain-specific Assessment (presentation or practical demonstration) and then a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job and how long does it last?
faq.answer: No, it is an internship for an initial six (06) months. It is not an employment contract and gives no right to employment with FDDI; any extension follows the ACIP Policy.
